name: std::ranges::slide_view<V>::iterator<Const>::operator[]

declarations.code:
constexpr auto operator[](difference_type pos) const

    requires ranges::random_access_range<Base>;

intro:
Returns an element at specified relative location.

Let current_ and n_ be the underlying data members. Equivalent to: return views::counted(current_ + pos, n_);.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
pos

 -

 position relative to current location

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The element (of type value_type) at displacement pos relative to the current location.

examples.title: Practical example
examples.input: Build a slide_view over the arrays below, read the first item, and move to the next position.
